title: Quality Assurance Director
text:
**Quality Assurance Director – Folding Carton Packaging**

Carton Service CSI, LLC | Shelby, OH | Full-time, salaried (exempt) | On-site with occasional travel

**About Us**

Our site runs a food safety management system built to the SQF Food Safety Code (Edition 9). To learn more about us, visit www.cartonservice.com.

**The Role**

Reporting to the President, the Quality Assurance Director leads quality assurance across all our carton production. You'll make sure our products meet customer specifications and expectations, keep our quality and food safety systems current, and drive cost-effective quality improvements as a key contributor to our strategic plans.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead and develop the QA team and oversee the plant quality system
* Review and approve customer specs, and make sure CSI procedures are followed
* Conduct and document internal, supplier and customer audits, manage our FSC and IMS certifications, and serve as backup SQF Practitioner
* Champion GMPs for food-contact packaging, from low-migration inks to hygiene
* Represent us with customers and suppliers, and partner with internal departments, including Sales and Production

**What You Bring**

* College education in a related field (bachelor's degree preferred)
* 5+ years experience working in a GFSI Certified production plant, preferably packaging
* Proven success leading teams, including cross-functional teams
* Strong communication skills with associates, customers, suppliers and regulators
* Organized and results-driven, able to manage multiple priorities and people

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with SQF, BRCGS or another GFSI food safety program
* FSC chain-of-custody or IMS program experience
* SQF Practitioner, HACCP or auditor training; Microsoft Access skills

**Work Environment**

Office work plus time on the production floor (noise, moving machinery; PPE required) and occasional travel to customer and supplier sites. Must be able to stand, walk, bend and kneel frequently and lift up to 25 lbs.

**What We Offer**

* Salary commensurate with experience
* Medical, Rx, dental and vision insurance
* Short- and long-term disability
* 9 paid holidays plus vacation
* 401(k)

**Ready to Apply?**

Apply through Indeed or send your resume and salary expectations to resume@cartonservice.com.

*Carton Service CSI, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Experience:

* quality (GFSI certified): 5 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
